title: bandolier down-all output
description: Every bandolier container stopped. cli-spec.md §6 (Lifecycle / SSD). Data always persists. Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

projects.description: Every discovered project, sorted by name.

stopped.description: Names of the projects actually stopped by this call, sorted.

stray_containers.description: bandolier-* containers removed that no manifest claims — residue of a deleted project.

docker_available.description: False when the daemon was unreachable; nothing can be running then, so that is a no-op success.
